summary.coverage_note: This inventory establishes a denominator of vendor‑specific YANG modules available in the YangModels repository and maps PulseForge gNMI paths to OpenConfig module names. It does NOT assert leaf‑level XPath coverage.

notes: OpenConfig YANG models are hosted in the OpenConfig/public repository, not in YangModels/yang. This inventory maps PulseForge gNMI paths to OpenConfig module names for documentation, not as proof of YANG‑file existence.
Vendor‑specific YANG modules (Cisco‑IOS‑XR, Juniper, Huawei, etc.) are present in the repository as submodules or in‑repo trees. No leaf‑level validation is performed.
Workstream C is intentionally bounded: it enumerates what exists in the pinned repository and maps PulseForge gNMI paths to known YANG modules.
